caption: The drawing depicts a square pattern composed of alternating dark blue and white sections, rendered against a plain off-white background. The square is divided into a symmetrical grid, with each corner featuring a solid dark blue square adjacent to a solid white square, both of similar size. Between the corners, the sides of the square contain stripes that alternate between dark blue and white, oriented in parallel lines. The center area of the square contains a diamond-shaped pattern with alternating diagonal blue and white stripes that are denser and create a sense of rotation. The pattern is highly regular, with clear distinction between the blue and white colors. The edges of the square are neatly defined, and the overall pattern appears woven or stitched. There are small hand-written text and numbers at the lower left and right corners of the background, reading “3169-B.” and “Ruth M. Barnes.”
title: Coverlet (Section of)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
